#Module mediatracks

The track lists of a media element (src/page/media_tracks.odin, media_texttracks.odin): AudioTrackList, VideoTrackList and TextTrackList (EventTargets: addtrack / removetrack / change), the AudioTrack / VideoTrack / TextTrack they hold, the TextTrackCue / VTTCue and TextTrackCueList of a text track, and the <track> element. The audio and video tracks are built from what the container demuxer announced; text tracks come from <track src> (WebVTT, parsed natively by media.vtt_parse) or addTextTrack. Which cues are active is tracked by the player's time and the shell draws the showing tracks over the video.

Exposed to: Window. Source: api/media_tracks.widl.
